acceptance: It is a postcard, technically, but I am prepared to overlook the geographical inaccuracy.
A snow globe. A tiny office where the weather is somebody else's problem.
You remembered my birthday. Thank you.
I will find it a place that is not on top of a personnel file.

helpLines: Before we return to the paperwork: thank you for the birthday gesture.
I can explain the alias without handing you somebody else's private personnel file. 'Commissioner' was an old alias used by our supervisor. Gordon.
That tells you whose authorization to ask about. It does not establish who typed the questioned insurance entry.
For the operation's approval and any separately filed search records, take the discrepancy to Gordon. Ask him directly.
And do not say that HR told you to break into anything. HR has enough forms.

messages.tooEarly: You know about Marge's birthday. Complete the sixth agency mission before this follow-up.
messages.noGift: Buy a postcard or a souvenir snow globe in the existing city shop, then bring it back. No money is taken in HR.
messages.given: Gift delivered. Click Marge to continue the insurance inquiry.
messages.done: New lead: the Commissioner alias belongs to Gordon. Ask the supervisor about the operation's authorization.
messages.saveFailed: Progress changed in memory, but automatic saving failed. Save manually before closing the game.
